mapper.select: select id::text as id, entry_date, raw_content, feedback_headline, feedback_summary, corrected_content, model_name, is_perfect as perfect, last_corrected_at from diary_entries where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and entry_date = #{entryDate} limit 1
select original_line, corrected_line, translation_line, line_order from diary_entry_feedback_lines where diary_entry_id = cast(#{entryId} as uuid) order by line_order asc
select note_type, content, note_order from diary_entry_feedback_notes where diary_entry_id = cast(#{entryId} as uuid) order by note_type asc, note_order asc
select entry_date from diary_entries where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and entry_date between #{fromDate} and #{toDate} order by entry_date asc

select de.id::text as id, de.entry_date, left(replace(de.raw_content, E'\n', ' '), 160) as raw_snippet, left(coalesce(replace(de.corrected_content, E'\n', ' '), ''), 160) as corrected_snippet, coalesce( string_agg(den.content, '||' order by den.note_order) filter (where den.note_type = 'keyword'), '' ) as keywords from diary_entries de left join diary_entry_feedback_notes den on den.diary_entry_id = de.id where de.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) group by de.id order by de.entry_date desc limit #{limit}

insert into diary_entries ( user_id, entry_date, raw_content, feedback_headline, feedback_summary, corrected_content, model_name, is_perfect, last_corrected_at ) values ( cast(#{userId} as uuid), #{entryDate}, #{rawContent}, #{feedbackHeadline}, #{feedbackSummary}, #{correctedContent}, #{modelName}, #{isPerfect}, #{lastCorrectedAt} ) returning id::text
mapper.update: update diary_entries set raw_content = #{rawContent}, feedback_headline = #{feedbackHeadline}, feedback_summary = #{feedbackSummary}, corrected_content = #{correctedContent}, model_name = #{modelName}, is_perfect = #{isPerfect}, last_corrected_at = #{lastCorrectedAt} where id = cast(#{entryId} as uuid)
mapper.delete: delete from diary_entry_feedback_lines where diary_entry_id = cast(#{entryId} as uuid)
delete from diary_entry_feedback_notes where diary_entry_id = cast(#{entryId} as uuid)
mapper.insert: insert into diary_entry_feedback_lines ( diary_entry_id, line_order, original_line, corrected_line, translation_line ) values ( cast(#{entryId} as uuid), #{lineOrder}, #{originalLine}, #{correctedLine}, #{translationLine} )
insert into diary_entry_feedback_notes ( diary_entry_id, note_type, note_order, content ) values ( cast(#{entryId} as uuid), #{noteType}, #{noteOrder}, #{content} )
